value.rationale: Unused bank credit is a natural capacity statistic not fixed by the macroscopic saturation statement. The exact geometric limit yields the bank exhaustion probability and mean reserve; the joint law shows that transfer-rate asymmetry changes order-one bank liquidity while leaving each fixed set of wealth marginals unchanged. The explicit kappa=delta=1 example separates empty-bank probabilities 1/2 and 3/4 at the same wealth profile, a motivated structural distinction.
